name: Flight 14
summary: Starship's first orbital flight. Super Heavy B21 and Ship 41, both Block 3 vehicles, lifted off from Starbase's Pad 2. A booster engine went out on ascent and one of the ship's Raptor Vacuum engines shut down early. Mission control first ruled out orbit, then reversed the call: Ship 41 reached a 262 × 275 km orbit, deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites, then deorbited early and splashed down north of Hawaii.
highlights: First Starship to reach orbit, 18 years to the day after Falcon 1's first orbit
First operational payload: 26 Starlink V3 satellites (~26 Tbps of capacity)
First deorbit burn and first header-tank-fed in-space Raptor burn
First live HD video from orbit relayed by Starlink
Ship 41 splashdown several hundred km north of Hawaii after 3 h 08 min

payload.name: Starlink Group 31-1

boosterFate: Soft splashdown in the Gulf a few miles off the Texas coast; flight termination system demonstrated
shipFate: Splashdown several hundred km north of Hawaii; tipped over and exploded seconds later
